parts.doc: How long the pull requests still open at the cut-off had been waiting

metrics.label: Pull requests open at the cut-off
metrics.definition: Pull requests created before the cut-off and neither merged nor closed then, by their own events

metrics.label: Median age of open pull requests
metrics.definition: Median of (cut-off minus opened) over the pull requests open at the cut-off

metrics.label: Open pull requests waiting two weeks or more
metrics.definition: Share of the pull requests open at the cut-off that had been open 14 days or more
